subject: Emotions
title: Hiring for EQ
description: A quick win: understand Hiring for EQ.

hook.text: Southwest Airlines rejects technically perfect pilots who fail their humor and warmth interview. EQ is non-negotiable.

buildup.text: Zappos offers new hires $2,000 to quit. Those who take it lack the emotional commitment the culture demands.

discovery.text: Research shows EQ predicts job performance in roles requiring social interaction better than IQ or experience.

twist.text: But EQ is hard to measure in interviews. Self-report is unreliable—narcissists routinely rate themselves as empathetic.

climax.text: Situational judgment tests work better: 'A colleague is upset. What do you do?' People reveal EQ through scenarios.

punchline.text: You can teach skills. You can't easily teach someone to care.

quiz.question: How does Zappos test emotional commitment?
